Identified as this saint because: Found by route 3: ru.wikipedia's article «Сабурова, Соломония Юрьевна» carries wikibase_item Q543564, whose P373 is `Category:Saint Sophia of Suzdal`. This file's own Commons description is «София Суздальская», exactly the Russian form this folder stores (name page «София Суздальская, прп.»), and Solomonia Saburova is that saint: the grand prince's wife tonsured at the Pokrovsky monastery in Suzdal, kept on 16 December in the Russian calendar, whose name in religion is the one the folder stores. A single-figure icon, 777x2277, so nothing has to be read out of a group. No guessed title reaches it: Commons files her under the name in religion while Wikidata labels her under the name in the world. Commons describes it: София Суздальская
